description: Radial menu component that expands actions around a center button, with overflow and shortcut support.

events.description: Emitted when the active menu item changes.
events.name: active-change

events.description: Emitted when the overflow menu closes.
events.name: more-close

events.description: Emitted when the overflow menu opens.
events.name: more-open

events.description: Emitted when a menu item is selected.
events.name: select
events.signature: (event: "select", index: string, indexPath: string[], item: FlRadialMenuResolvedItem, context: FlRadialMenuSelectContext): void
events.type: [index: string, indexPath: string[], item: FlRadialMenuResolvedItem, context: FlRadialMenuSelectContext]

events.description: Requests external synchronization of menu open state.
events.name: update:modelValue

exposes.description: Toggle the menu between open and closed.
exposes.name: toggle

props.description: Accessible label for the center button.
props.name: centerLabel

props.description: Whether selecting an item closes the menu automatically.
props.name: closeOnSelect

props.description: Visual type for menu item buttons.
props.name: itemType

props.description: Maximum number of items displayed directly on the ring.
props.name: maxRingItems

props.description: Whether the menu uses inline or floating layout.
props.name: mode

props.description: Controls whether the menu is open.
props.name: modelValue

props.description: How overflow items are exposed through the more entry.
props.name: moreMode

props.description: Keyboard shortcut used to open or close the menu.
props.name: shortcut

props.description: Whether the keyboard shortcut is enabled.
props.name: shortcutEnabled

props.description: Whether the menu overlay is mounted elsewhere in the page.
props.name: teleport

props.description: Whether click or hover opens the menu.
props.name: trigger

slots.description: Declare custom menu items with child item components.
slots.name: default
